ei.subject: 수능특강Light 영어
ei.title: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon.

fullPassage: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon. Ann Marie did a final check of her scuba gear, and then dropped into the sea with the other divers. Several minutes into the dive, a metallic clang interrupted the quiet. One of the divemasters knocked on her tank to get everyone's attention. She pointed to a grayish blur forming in the distance. A shadowy fin emerged, and then Ann Marie saw a uniquely shaped head followed by a powerful, streamlined body. The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby. It was a great hammerhead shark. In a moment, another shadow joined the first and then another. Soon, dozens of hammerheads glided effortlessly past the divers. It was astonishing and beautiful. Ann Marie wished there was a way to make the moment last.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ drop → dropped. 과거 시제 문맥이므로 drop의 과거형 dropped가 와야 합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① stretched: 과거형 → 적절
✅ ② did: do의 과거형 → 적절
❌ ③ drop → dropped: 과거 시제 일치(stretched, did, interrupted). drop의 과거형은 dropped.
✅ ④ interrupted: 과거형 → 적절
det.tip: 과거 시제 일치: and 앞뒤 동사 모두 과거형

det.korean: ④ form → forming. 명사 blur를 수식하는 현재분사. '형성되고 있는' 능동 진행.

✅ ② to get: 부사적 용법(목적) → 적절

det.tip: wish + 가정법 과거: wished there was/were ~ (~이 있었으면)

questions.passage: On the boat, water stretched to every horizon. Ann Marie did a final check of her scuba gear, and then dropped into the sea with the other divers. Several minutes into the dive, a metallic clang interrupted the quiet. One of the divemasters knocked on her tank to get everyone's attention. She pointed to a grayish blur forming in the distance. A shadowy fin emerged, and then Ann Marie saw a uniquely shaped head followed by a powerful, streamlined body. The unmistakable rectangular feature made it easy to identify the enormous creature swimming nearby. It was a great hammerhead shark. In a moment, another shadow joined the first and then another. Soon, dozens of hammerheads glided effortlessly past the divers. It was astonishing and beautiful. Ann Marie wished there was a way to make the moment last.

questions.stem: 윗글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약할 때, 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? During a scuba dive, Ann Marie (A)__________ dozens of hammerhead sharks and was (B)__________ by their beauty.

det.korean: (A) encountered(마주쳤다) (B) amazed(놀란)
det.analysis:
✅ ③ encountered — amazed: 귀상어 무리를 '만나' 그 아름다움에 '놀랐다'.
❌ ① avoided — frightened: 회피 아님
❌ ② attacked — injured: 공격 아님
❌ ④ captured — pleased: 잡은 것 아님
det.tip: encounter = 우연히 만나다. amazed = 놀란
